reconcile.note: Henry explains the Israel-only restriction applied only to the disciples' first mission, later superseded by the command to teach all nations.

discrepancy.note: Strauss argues the disciples' failure to act on the universal command shows it was not historically given at that point.

quotes.text: Not only, however, do the disciples, after the first Pentecost, neglect to execute this command, but when a case is thrust on them which offers them an opportunity for compliance with it, they act as if they were altogether ignorant that such a direction had been given by Jesus ( Acts x. , xi. ).
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined, §68 (1846), on Matthew 10:5 and Matthew 28:19.
